question: For each financial aid year and academic year, list the number of fiscal periods, quarters, the start term date, the end term date, and number of distinct department-level term parameters.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "time_month" AS SELECT "fiscal_period" AS "fiscal_period", "fiscal_year" AS "fiscal_year", "fiscal_year_quarter" AS "fiscal_year_quarter", "fy_quarter_code" AS "fy_quarter_code", "academic_year" AS "academic_year", "academic_term" AS "academic_term", "financial_aid_year" AS "financial_aid_year" FROM beaver."time_month";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "time_quarter" AS SELECT "fiscal_year" AS "fiscal_year", "fy_quarter_code" AS "fy_quarter_code" FROM beaver."time_quarter";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "academic_terms" AS SELECT "term_code" AS "term_code", "term_start_date" AS "term_start_date", "term_end_date" AS "term_end_date", "academic_year" AS "academic_year", "financial_aid_year" AS "financial_aid_year" FROM beaver."academic_terms";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "academic_term_parameter" AS SELECT "term_parameter" AS "term_parameter", "term_indicator" AS "term_indicator", "term_code" AS "term_code" FROM beaver."academic_term_parameter";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subject_grouping" AS SELECT "term_code" AS "term_code", "department_code" AS "department_code" FROM beaver."subject_grouping";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH 
-- Normalize time_month scoped by FAY and AY
month_scoped AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(financial_aid_year AS VARCHAR) AS fay,
        CAST(academic_year AS VARCHAR) AS ay,
        fiscal_period,
        fy_quarter_code
    FROM time_month
    WHERE financial_aid_year IS NOT NULL OR academic_year IS NOT NULL
),
-- Fiscal counts per FAY/AY
fiscal_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        fay,
        ay,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_period) AS num_fiscal_periods,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fy_quarter_code) AS num_fiscal_quarters
    FROM month_scoped
    GROUP BY fay, ay
),
-- Term date ranges per FAY/AY from academic_terms
term_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(financial_aid_year AS VARCHAR) AS fay,
        CAST(academic_year AS VARCHAR) AS ay,
        MIN(TRY_CAST(term_start_date AS DATE)) AS start_term_date,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(term_end_date AS DATE)) AS end_term_date
    FROM academic_terms
    GROUP BY CAST(financial_aid_year AS VARCHAR), CAST(academic_year AS VARCHAR)
),
-- Map term -> FAY/AY using academic_terms
term_to_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        at.term_code,
        CAST(at.financial_aid_year AS VARCHAR) AS fay,
        CAST(at.academic_year AS VARCHAR) AS ay
    FROM academic_terms at
),
-- Department-level term parameters: join parameters to departments via term_code, count distinct param x dept
dept_term_params AS (
    SELECT 
        tty.fay,
        tty.ay,
        atp.term_parameter,
        sg.department_code
    FROM academic_term_parameter atp
    JOIN term_to_years tty ON tty.term_code = atp.term_code
    JOIN subject_grouping sg ON sg.term_code = atp.term_code
    WHERE atp.term_parameter IS NOT NULL AND sg.department_code IS NOT NULL
),
param_counts AS (
    SELECT fay, ay, COUNT(DISTINCT term_parameter || '|' || department_code) AS num_distinct_dept_term_params
    FROM dept_term_params
    GROUP BY fay, ay
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(fc.fay, td.fay, pc.fay) AS financial_aid_year,
    COALESCE(fc.ay, td.ay, pc.ay) AS academic_year,
    COALESCE(fc.num_fiscal_periods, 0) AS num_fiscal_periods,
    COALESCE(fc.num_fiscal_quarters, 0) AS num_fiscal_quarters,
    td.start_term_date,
    td.end_term_date,
    COALESCE(pc.num_distinct_dept_term_params, 0) AS num_distinct_dept_term_parameters
FROM fiscal_counts fc
FULL OUTER JOIN term_dates td ON td.fay = fc.fay AND td.ay = fc.ay
FULL OUTER JOIN param_counts pc ON pc.fay = COALESCE(fc.fay, td.fay) AND pc.ay = COALESCE(fc.ay, td.ay)
ORDER BY financial_aid_year NULLS LAST, academic_year NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200

fc_td AS (

        COALESCE(fc.fay, td.fay) AS fay,

        at.term_code,
